_DESIGN_RULE: Every number here is a FIRST-PASS GUESS - the v3 loop (threshold reveals, product tray, Trust->Patience conversion, wallets) is not in DESIGN_V2 at all. Retune here between playtests; never edit engine.py to change balance. Ratios worth defending: actions_per_round against hand_size, because a hand you can fully play is a hand with no decisions in it (m0 lesson 4); reassure_patience_gain against a fast archetype's decay, because a flat refill is deliberately worth fewer rounds on a fast burner; and budget_max against the margin ladder, because a customer's WALLET is the cap on what they are worth to you - the two needs sum to at most 13, so a budget_max below that means nobody is ever fully monetisable. max_rounds is a SAFETY VALVE, not a clock: Reassure can out-pace decay indefinitely, so without a backstop a shift is not guaranteed to terminate. Careful play ends around round 14, so 40 never binds - if it starts binding, stalling has become viable and Reassure needs a real cost.
